sources.note: Nothing. The Kakkala sketch (pp. 28-31) gives ethnographic notes, pronouns, numerals, tense/person morphology and a word list; there is no phonology section for Kakkala and the words 'stress'/'accent' do not occur anywhere in the 58-page issue. Its bibliography names two unpublished 1980 University of Kerala MA theses (Sheela V; Abdul Kalam Azad M.).
